dct_description_sm: This theme includes all OpenStreetMap features in this area matching ( Learn what tags means [here](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Tags) ) : tags['amenity'] IN ('mobile_money_agent','bureau_de_change','bank','microfinance','atm','sacco','money_transfer','post_office') Features may have these attributes: - [name](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:name) - [name:en](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:name:en) - [amenity](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:amenity) - [operator](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:operator) - [network](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:network) - [addr:full](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:addr:full) - [addr:city](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:addr:city) - [source](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:source) - [name:af](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:name:af) - [name:nr](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:name:nr) - [name:st](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:name:st) - [name:nso](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:name:nso) - [name:ssw](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:name:ssw) - [name:ts](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:name:ts) - [name:tn](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:name:tn) - [name:ve](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:name:ve) - [name:xh](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:name:xh) - [name:zu](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:name:zu) This dataset is one of many [OpenStreetMap exports on HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hot). See the [Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team](http://hotosm.org/) website for more information.
